source: 4 AlexDiary shorts measured frame by frame on 2026-11-22 (docs/analysis/reference-shorts-frame-notes.md). Camera from optical flow of the Bridge short; ours from window.__camAt.

facts.hard_cuts: 0-1 per film, only as a punchline
facts.camera_height_m: 1-6 m (one high shot at the end)
facts.captions: centre, 2 words, white + a colour that changes every pair
facts.congratulations: 3-4 per film; low camera looking up, hero small, structure big
facts.transitions: 1.5-2 s eased pans, foreground wipes (boat, person, animal), dust or haze; whips rarely
facts.cast: a recurring hero + recurring villains + 8-12 extras always doing something
facts.cause_effect: every result is preceded on screen by the thing that causes it (a robber swings, then the wall breaks)
